title: Caregivers
overview: This guide covers caregivers workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Browse the system caregivers roster
subtasks.purpose: Locate a specific system caregiver from the master roster and filter by status.

steps.title: Open Caregivers List
steps.description: Click Caregivers in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Search Caregivers
steps.description: Type any part of a name, address, phone or email into the Search caregivers… box; results filter as you type.

steps.title: Filter by Status
steps.description: Optionally choose Active / Inactive / All Status from the top-right dropdown to narrow the roster.

steps.title: Sort Caregiver List
steps.description: Sort by clicking Status or Name column headers.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Delete Caregiver
steps.description: For any row, click the blue eye icon to view the profile, the pencil to edit, or the red trash icon to delete. Notes The Status chip (A = Active, I = Inactive) reflects whether the caregiver can log in and receive assignments. Rows shown here are system caregivers pooled across practices — practice-scoped caregivers appear under the Practice detail → Caregivers tab instead.

subtasks.title: View a caregiver profile (eye icon)
subtasks.purpose: Inspect a caregiver’s contact information and assignments without making changes.

steps.title: Open Caregiver Profile
steps.description: From the Caregivers list, click the eye icon on the target row.

steps.title: Return to Roster
steps.description: Use the back / List button to return to the roster. Notes The profile view is safe to share for verification — no edits can be made from this screen.

subtasks.title: Edit a caregiver (pencil icon)
subtasks.purpose: Update a caregiver’s contact details or change their active status.

steps.title: Open Edit Caregiver Form
steps.description: Click the pencil icon on the target caregiver row.

steps.title: Update Caregiver Details
steps.description: Update name, address, phone, cell phone, fax or email as needed.

steps.title: Toggle Caregiver Status
steps.description: Toggle Status between Active and Inactive if the caregiver’s login should be enabled or disabled.

steps.title: Save or Cancel Edit
steps.description: Click Save to commit, or Cancel to discard changes. Notes Setting Status = Inactive preserves the record but prevents sign-in and removes the caregiver from selectable lists on new assignments. Email changes trigger a verification email if two-factor authentication is enabled.

subtasks.title: Delete a caregiver (trash icon)
subtasks.purpose: Permanently remove a caregiver record from the system.

steps.title: Delete Caregiver
steps.description: Click the red trash icon on the target row.

steps.title: Confirm Deletion
steps.description: Confirm the deletion in the modal. Notes Prefer Inactive over Delete when the caregiver has historical patient interactions — deletion is irreversible. Task 6.4 — Inventory
